captions.detailed: A light gray, minimal bicycle front fork assembly featuring wide flat handlebars, a stem, and oversized fork blades. The head tube is tapered, housing a steerer column. The entire handlebar, stem, and fork blade system rotates relative to the head tube via a revolute joint, simulating steering articulation.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a fat bike fork assembly in CadQuery. The model should include a tapered head tube, a wide alloy crown, long oversized fork blades, a stem, and flat handlebars, with a revolute joint allowing the fork and handlebars to steer relative to the head tube.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject containing two main parts: the head tube (parent) and the steering assembly (child). The head tube is modeled using a tapered cylinder. The steering assembly is built by combining a steerer tube (cylinder), a wide flat crown (extruded rounded rectangle), two tapered fork blades (lofted or extruded profiles), a forward-reaching stem (box/cylinder), and a wide handlebar (long cylinder). A revolute joint is defined along the Z-axis to connect the steering assembly to the head tube, enabling realistic steering motion.
